snippet.title: I Choreographed Boss Fights to Classical Music (Playtest Started)
snippet.description:
🎮  Join the Playtest on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3286040/Not_My_Tempo/

Not My Tempo is a newly announced boss-brawler with a twist: every move, dash, and boss attack is painstakingly choreographed to classical music.

Each stage is built around a famous masterpiece, recomposed from scratch into a cinematic boss encounter.

#indiegame #gamedev
